note: The contract permits the control window to be re-run after a diagnosed apparatus repair at most twice. A third fault ships the project as 'the measurement could not be completed' with the three diagnoses. This counter lives in the repository rather than in anyone's recollection. The control-window run was executed once, on 2026-08-06, with no apparatus fault; the single permitted re-run was consumed by the identifier fault before it. The holdout is governed by a different clause and carries no re-run allowance at all.

faults.diagnosis: adr/0009-openaq-disagreement-grading.md, section 'APPARATUS FAULT: the instrument was reading the wrong sensors entirely'
faults.summary: admitted_sensors() assigned an OpenAQ location id to a field named sensor_id; nothing resolved it to a sensor id. /v3/sensors/{location_id}/hours returned unrelated sensors, three of four New York stations returning ozone in ppm recorded as PM2.5 in ug/m3. Defect is in T2-shipped code, not only in the capture script.
